newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Continental Mariner cuts stake in Poly.
newsitem.headline: Continental Mariner cuts stake in Poly.

text.p: Poly Investments Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its controlling shareholder Continental Mariner Investment Co Ltd had cut its stake to 686.45 million shares or 56.57 percent after recent share sales.

Poly said its parent had disposed of a total of 29.26 million shares, or 2.14 percent of Poly's share capital, on January 6 and 7 before selling a further 10.63 million shares, or 0.8896 percent, on January 8.
It gave no details of the selling price of the shares.
Poly shares were down HK$0.05 at HK$0.92 at midday on Tuesday.
